sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Parasitaxus usta is a small conifer endemic to Grande Terre, New Caledonia. About 1–1.5 m tall, it grows in humid forest understory and parasitises the roots or base of Falcatifolium taxoides.

sections.title: Leaves and cones
sections.text: Its axes bear tightly packed triangular scale leaves. The pollen cones are tiny; mature seed cones have a glaucous appearance.

sections.title: Edibility and depiction
sections.text: No food use is documented. The plate shows neither a host plant nor the parasitic relationship and depicts bright red structures that do not match the glaucous mature cones described by the local source.
